doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

title: Old man Dorsey on bass, Eddie Dawson, and the Luley Oster band
summary: Peter's father played with Dorsey, a bass player. Tom distinguishes Eddie Dawson, who played guitar with him, from the older Dorsey. Dorsey's band, with Cantrell, Albert Gibberell and others, played picnics at Luley Oster, where Tom lived as a boy.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Now you take, the old man he used to play with Peter Port.

The old man was Peter's daddy.

Who was this Dorsey? Dorsey was a bass player. A bass player. Yes. It isn't Eddie Dawson, the one that we know Eddie. Eddie Dawson.
Eddie Dawson. Well Eddie Dawson used to play with me.
Eddie Dawson now you're talking about. No relation, not the same family.
Yeah.

Well he used to play with me Eddie Dawson. Yeah Eddie Dawson. Well he used to play bass I think he did. Who did? No guitar. Eddie Dawson. Yeah. Yeah he played guitar with me. I just came down around the jump all around through there. I just carried a Dorsey. I just carried almost all of them.
This other Dorsey, what was he like? A bass player you say? Was he a good bass player?
That I was.
You mentioned this other Dorsey.
Yeah, old Dorsey.
Oh yes. He used to take all the picnics down in Luley Oster. The place we call Luley Oster. Right on by the neighbor station.
Did he live across the river? Yeah he lived across the river. He worked over there most of the time? Yes, that's what he lived. And Feeder Father used to play with him.
And this fellow Cantrell used to play.
Yeah well his dad would play the drums.

And Bicu used to play the clarinet. Albert Gibberell used to play at times with him. And the old man Cantrell used to play banjo with him. Well they used to play together. Some of them had a big band there in Luley Oster. They had a flat for them from amongst them trees there on a Sunday night. Right in Luley Oster. Well I was living there in Luley Oster. And I used to hear them every night. That's the time I would start to play music then. But I had my own little band. Yeah. Yeah.
